title: Singapore Shares May Extend Friday's Losses
text:
Singapore Shares May Extend Friday's Losses April 22, 2018, 08:04:  Singapore stock market on Friday ended the three-  climbed more than 100 points or 2.9 percent. The Straits Times index now rests just beneath the 3,575-point plateau and it's looking at another soft start   STI finished modestly lower on Friday following losses from the financials, properties and industrials. 
For the day, the index slid 25.35 points or 0.70 percent to finish at 3,573.38 after trading between 3,560.21 and 3,596.54. Volume was 1.5 billion shares worth 1.4 billion Singapore dollars. There were 271 decliners and 144 gainers. 
Among the actives, Venture Corporation plummeted 12.25 percent, while Golden Agri-Resources surged 2.94 percent, SembCorp Industries soared 2.53 percent, Yangzijiang Shipbuilding plunged 2.42 percent, Comfort DelGro tumbled 2.23 percent, CapitaLand Commercial Trust skidded 2.15 percent, Keppel Corp climbed 1.73 percent, Hutchison Port Holdings dropped 1.49 percent, DBS Group retreated 1.07 percent, CapitaLand lost 1.06 percent, Ascendas REIT was down 0.73 percent, SingTel fell 0.58 percent, United Overseas Bank dipped 0.30 percent, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation eased 0.07 percent and Thai Beverage, Genting Singapore and Wilmar International were unchanged.
